title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #12 OPERATION BASE POINT OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #12 OPERATION BASE POINT OPEN
DURATION: October 1, 2023, 10:00 – October 15, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-10

SEASON DETAILS: It is the final season of Contingency Contract. During the season, players can combine different "Contracts" to clear stages, complete challenges, improve level evaluation, and collect "Contract Bounty" and "Operation Agreement."
- "Contract Bounty" can be used to redeem rewards in "Secret Sanctuary.”
- "Operation Agreement" can be used to unlock more Contingency Contract contents.
CROSS-SEASON "SECRET SANCTUARY" OPEN
- Cross-Season Permanent Trade Center New Arrivals:
EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals - ‘Fantastic Crafts’ for Astesia
Test Collection Series - ‘Fresh Fastener’ for Amiya (Re-edition)
Season #12 Furniture – Base Point Pennant
Event Furniture - 'Contingency Memories'
- Season #12 Special Trade Center Supplies: Elite Materials, Module Materials, LMD, Furniture Parts, Battle Records, Chips, etc.
DURATION: October 1, 2023, 10:00 – October 15, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
NOTE:
- You do not need Sanity to play Contingency Contract stages.
- You need a certain number of completed Contracts to unlock some other Contracts. Please note that the number of completed Contracts DOES NOT EQUAL to Contingency Level.

- Compared with Season #11, Season #12 still has 8 sites in total, but has replaced 2 sites from the previous Season. There will be a new Rotating Operation Site and a new Permanent Operation Site, and the Permanent Operation Site from last Season will be added into Rotating Operation Sites. During the season, there will be 1 Permanent Operation Site and 7 Rotating Operation Sites (rotating daily) for you to challenge.
(The first Rotating Operation Site's rotation time and its corresponding challenges on the first day of the event will be extended by 1 day.)
- Several new Contracts and challenge missions will be added to the Season's Permanent Operation Site on October 1, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7).
- After Season #12 ends, the unused Contract Bounty will be retained.
- After Season #12 ends, all the Operation Agreements you have collected this season will be automatically converted into Operation Base Point Supplies. The ratio is 1:1.
- During Season #12, you will receive Credits if your Support Units have helped others in clearing their Contingency Contract stages.
- During Season #12, players can obtain Season #12 Engraved Medal Set by achieving related goals.
02 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DURATION: October 1, 2023, 10:00 – October 15, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting, [Joint Operation], opens and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6* and 5* Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Irene / Lee / Dorothy / Thorns
★★★★★: Istina / Blacknight / Andreana / Flint / Quercus / Nightmare
03 SUPPLIES & CHIPS EVERYDAY ACCESS
DURATION: October 1, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - October 15, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies stay open during the period above.
